Storefront and customer routes of the newsletter module. Send `Accept-Language` (or `X-Locale` from a browser) on every call; a customer route needs the session cookie.

## GET /v1/newsletter/confirm

Confirm a newsletter subscription

Parameters:

- `locale` in query (string, required).
- `token` in query (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: no description.
- `302`: Redirect to the storefront confirmation page.

## POST /v1/newsletter/subscribe

Subscribe to the newsletter (double opt-in)

Request body: [SubscribeDto](#subscribedto).

Responses:

- `202`: Confirmation email sent if applicable.
- `400`: Invalid email.

## GET /v1/newsletter/unsubscribe

Unsubscribe via the email footer link

Parameters:

- `locale` in query (string, required).
- `token` in query (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: no description.
- `302`: Redirect to the storefront confirmation page.

## POST /v1/newsletter/unsubscribe

One-click newsletter unsubscribe (RFC 8058)

Parameters:

- `token` in query (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Opted out.

## Schemas

### SubscribeDto

- `locale` (string, optional).
- `email` (string, max length 254, required).
